chapters.title: Boot to the front end
chapters.goal: Get past the boot and intro to the game's front end (its title and attract screen).
hints: The DS boots into an intro; pressing START or A skips it.
Until the front end is reached, nothing else in this walkthrough applies.

chapters.title: Reach the main menu
chapters.goal: Get from the title screen to the game's main menu.
hints: The intro is an attract video: press START (or A) to skip to the title, then START again for the menu.
The menu is on the lower (touch) screen: Single Player, Multiplayer, Nintendo WFC, Options.
If a screen does not react to the D-pad, tap it: this game is driven by the touch screen.

chapters.title: Start a Grand Prix
chapters.goal: Start a Grand Prix race: Single Player, then Grand Prix, then a cup and a character.
hints: Single Player is the top-left button on the lower screen.
Grand Prix asks for an engine class (50cc first) and then a cup.
Pick a character and a kart; the game remembers the choice.

chapters.title: Win the Mushroom Cup (50cc)
chapters.goal: Finish first in the Mushroom Cup's four races on 50cc to take the cup.
hints: A accelerates, B brakes, the D-pad steers; hold R through a turn to drift and keep speed.
Items are used with X; a banana or a shell behind you is defence, not a mistake.
Points come from finishing position: 1st is 10, then 8, 6, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0.

chapters.title: Win the Flower Cup (50cc)
chapters.goal: Take the Flower Cup the same way, then the Star and Special cups.
hints: The cup screen shows which cups are open: winning unlocks the next one.
Shortcut jumps are usually not worth the risk without a mushroom item.

chapters.title: Move up to 100cc and 150cc
chapters.goal: Race the faster engine classes and the Mirror cups.
hints: Engine class is chosen on the Grand Prix screen; 100cc and 150cc unlock as cups are won.
Mirror cups appear once the 150cc cups are done.

chapters.title: Try Mission Mode
chapters.goal: Play Mission Mode to practise the game's mechanics and unlock the boss missions.
hints: Mission Mode is on the main menu, under Single Player.
Each mission gives a target: a lap time, a number of coins, a boss to beat.
